newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Castle sees 1996 EPS near 1995 level.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Castle sees 1996 EPS near 1995 level.

text.p: A. M. Castle & Co, a distributor of specialty metals, said based on results through September 30, it "anticipates that 1996 earnings will approximate last year's all-time high of $1.93 per share."
"Even with softer market conditions, Castle is on track to achieve its second strongest, if not the strongest, performance in our 106-year history," said chairman Michael Simpson.
The company said it expects gross margins to rise "to the plus side of 28 percent this year" from 27.6 percent in 1995.
"For 1997, we plan to further raise this target," said chief executive Richard Mork.
Shares in the company were off 1/8 to 19 following its announcement that third-quarter earnings were $0.38 per share, down from $0.39 per share a year earlier.
